title: Test the skill it claims
statement: The skill a lesson or item claims must be one its text affords and its task really demands at the stated depth, not recall or a neighbouring skill.
example: A probe of 18 inference items found 1 whose conclusion the passage stated outright.
detail: An integrity probe in the reading project extracted the expected conclusion of every inference-bearing item in three lessons and searched the lesson's own passage for a sentence stating it: of 18 items, 1 stated its conclusion outright and was fixed, and the reverse check found no retrieval item that secretly needed an unstated inference. The project's lesson rulings call a retrieval question dressed as an inference, or the reverse, a defect, not style. A gap analysis of its content-evaluation tools makes thinking-level alignment binding, coverage being false if an 'analyze' standard is assessed by 'identify', and a second-round review in July 2026 found a main-idea lesson serving an inference item. The depth asked can mean, for example, explaining a cause-and-effect link or weighing several causes. An identify task can't assess an analyze goal, and an inference whose conclusion the source states outright is retrieval however it is labelled.
against: In the response to an earlier review, one cited mistag was judged defensible. The higher-order rule comes from a practical guidance paper, not a systematic study, and the AP judge can still pass a factually correct question that teaches the wrong skill. The external audit rated that check medium and the course judged it not serious (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`, line 61); the item-statistics review rated it minor, noting it was framed as a comprehension pause rather than a strict locating item (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/lens-item-stats.md`, lines 245 and 258). No before-and-after measurement, and the difficulty finding paraphrases typical judge rationales rather than quoting one. These are adopted rules from writer prompts, untested one by one, and the synthesis rewrite is a single targeted repair. The gain was measured on the ten public items being patched, and a different sample then failed: "third public n=10 was `10/10`, but runner sanity failed `1/2`" (aptraining-local/den-of-ideation/to_main/2026-05-23T1808Z_DEN_REQUEST_validate_unit9_mcq_solver_v1.md, line 26).
